comparison.objective: Align a marked card in a desk punch and create two holes; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening limit.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar sheet alignment and lever pressing differ from seating two concentric tools and resisting tightening reaction.
comparison.success_condition: Two holes within 1.5 mm of marks versus a locked 90° setting retained through repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Lever operation and target registration do not test coupled adjustment retention.
